title: 完善 NowledgeMemAdapter 实现
description: 实现 INowledgeMemService 所有方法。当前 adapter 仅有 protocol 定义和基础测试，缺少实际 CLI 通信实现。
approach: 基于 INowledgeMemService 接口逐一实现每个方法，通过 Node child_process 调用 Nowledge Mem CLI 命令。每个方法实现后编写单测验证。

out_of_scope: 其他 adapter 实现文件

implementation_steps.action: 读取 INowledgeMemService 接口，列出所有待实现方法
implementation_steps.detail: 当前接口方法: addMemory, searchMemories, getMemory, updateMemory, deleteMemory, expandGraph, addToLibrary, searchLibrary, getWorkingMemory, setWorkingMemory, listCommunities, getFeed, summarizeMemories, createRelation, getRelatedMemories, addThread, searchThreads, importFromLibrary

implementation_steps.action: 实现 NowledgeMemAdapter 类的 CLI 通信基础设施
implementation_steps.detail: 添加 execNowledgeMem() 私有方法，封装 CLI 调用 + JSON 解析 + 错误处理。支持 configurable CLI path（默认 'nowledge-mem'）。

implementation_steps.action: 逐方法实现 CRUD 操作（addMemory, getMemory, updateMemory, deleteMemory, searchMemories）
implementation_steps.detail: CLI 命令映射: add → `nowledge-mem add`, get → `nowledge-mem get <id>`, search → `nowledge-mem search <query>`, update → `nowledge-mem update <id>`, delete → `nowledge-mem delete <id>`

implementation_steps.action: 实现图结构操作（expandGraph, createRelation, getRelatedMemories）
implementation_steps.detail: expandGraph → `nowledge-mem expand`, createRelation → `nowledge-mem relate`, getRelatedMemories → `nowledge-mem related <id>`

implementation_steps.action: 实现 Library/Community 操作（addToLibrary, searchLibrary, listCommunities, importFromLibrary）
implementation_steps.detail: Library 相关 CLI 命令封装。importFromLibrary 返回 ImportResult 结构。

implementation_steps.action: 实现 Thread 操作（addThread, searchThreads）
implementation_steps.detail: addThread → `nowledge-mem thread add`, searchThreads → `nowledge-mem thread search`

implementation_steps.action: 实现摘要和辅助操作（summarizeMemories, getWorkingMemory, setWorkingMemory, getFeed）
implementation_steps.detail: summarizeMemories → `nowledge-mem summarize`, working memory → `nowledge-mem working-memory`, getFeed → `nowledge-mem feed`
每个方法至少 1 个 happy path + 1 个 error path 测试。mock CLI exec 调用。

acceptance_criteria: INowledgeMemService 所有 18 个方法均有实际实现
每个方法有对应单测（happy path + error path）
CLI 通信封装健壮：超时、异常输出、非零退出码均处理

tests.strategy: mock CLI child_process.execSync，验证调用参数和返回值解析

risks.risk: Nowledge Mem CLI 命令格式不确定
risks.mitigation: 参考 INowledgeMemService 接口定义推断 CLI 命令格式，运行时验证
